title: 第17 章 火法应用第 18章 练习新法
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 沈回在灶房里忙活了一个多时辰，几道菜终于整整齐齐码在灶台上。
静慧不知什么时候从门槛上挪到了灶台边，盯着那几盘菜，嘴里不停念叨。
“好了没？好了没？”
“好了。”沈回擦擦手，“四师姐，帮忙端一下。”
静慧二话不说，一手端一盘，脚下生风往膳堂去了。
沈回和五师兄端着剩下的菜跟在后面。
膳堂里，大师兄、二师姐、三师兄已经坐定。沈回把菜摆上桌，余光瞥见门口进来一个人。
师父。
沈回一愣，下意识看向对方的脸。
那张原本被烧得七零八落的脸上，眉毛仍是那般惨状，半边有，半边无，下巴上却已冒出一层浅浅的白茬，如新割的麦地。
虽瞧着仍有些古怪，却比早上要顺眼多了。
沈回只看了一眼，就赶紧低下头。
其余几人也是，原本该打招呼的，此刻却都闷着头，假装在研究桌上的菜。
老道士施施然走到主位，撩起道袍坐下，目光扫过众人，又扫过桌上的菜，最后落在沈回身上。
“站着干什么？坐下。”
沈回连忙坐下。
一顿饭吃得鸦雀无声。
没人说话了。连筷子碰碗的声音都比平时轻了些。
沈回不敢抬头，只盯着自己碗里的饭，一口一口，嚼得认真。
老道士也没说话，慢慢夹菜，慢慢吃。
夹一块兔肉，嚼了嚼，点点头；夹一筷子地笋片，嚼了嚼，又点点头；喝一口蛋花汤，咂咂嘴，还是点点头。
一顿饭吃完，老道士放下筷子。
众人也跟着放下筷子。
“听说，你昨日与静明论道，说这人间烟火，也是一味大药？”老道忽然开口。
沈回心里咯噔一下。
他抬起头，正对上老道士那双似笑非笑的眼睛。
他想起昨日二师姐原本是不吃蘑菇的，结果被自己一通忽悠，最后竟也不慎中招，不禁有些汗颜。
他咽了口唾沫，斟酌着说：“弟子只是随口说说，当不得真……”
“随口说说？”
老道士捋了捋那参差不齐的胡子，语气里听不出喜怒。
“老夫倒觉得你说得颇有道理。”
沈回不敢接话。
老道士摇晃着脑袋，起身往外走，走到门口，头也不回地又说了一句：
“自今日起，老夫不辟谷了。”
话音落下，人影消失在门外，留下惊疑不定的六位弟子。
饭后，沈回忽然想起什么，转头对清逸说：“三师兄，我想借几本书看看，你那可有什么地理风物，民俗志异之类的杂书？”
清逸点点头：“倒是有不少。你是要我替你挑几本，还是自个儿来选？”
沈回刚要回答，结果二师姐冷不丁开口：“我那里有道藏经卷若干，你若想看书，可来寻我。”
沈回一愣，连忙摆手：“多谢二师姐好意，只是我道行太浅，那些道藏太过深奥，看了也是暴殄天物，实在不敢糟蹋。”
静明微微蹙眉：“那你看那些杂书又有何用处？岂非虚掷光阴，耽误修行。”
三师兄闻言，脸色顿时有些尴尬。
沈回倒是无所谓地笑了笑，随口答道：“师姐此言差矣，常言道：书中自有黄金屋，书中自有颜如玉嘛。”
清逸眼睛一亮：“师弟此话甚妙！”
静明却蹙眉更深：“黄金屋？颜如玉？你莫不是忘了门规？财帛女色……”
content_en:
Shen Hui worked in the kitchen for more than an hour, and finally several dishes were piled neatly on the stove.
Jinghui didn't know when she moved from the threshold to the stove, staring at the plates of food, and kept mumbling.
"Are you okay? Are you okay?"
"Okay." Shen Hui wiped his hands, "Fourth Senior Sister, help me carry it."
Without saying a word, Jinghui walked to the dining hall with a plate in one hand and the wind at her feet.
Shen Hui and Fifth Senior Brother followed behind carrying the remaining dishes.
In the dining hall, senior brother, second senior sister, and third senior brother were already seated. Shen Hui put the dishes on the table and caught a glimpse of someone coming in at the door.
Master.
Shen Hui was stunned and subconsciously looked at the other person's face.
On the face that was originally burned to pieces, the eyebrows were still in the same miserable state, half of them were there and half were missing, but a light layer of white stubble had appeared on the chin, like a newly cut wheat field.
Although it still looks a little strange, it is much more pleasing to the eye than in the morning.
Shen Hui only glanced at it and quickly lowered his head.
The same goes for the other people, who were supposed to say hello, but now they all had their heads down, pretending to study the dishes on the table.
The old Taoist Shi Shiran walked to the main seat, lifted up his Taoist robe and sat down. His eyes swept over everyone, then over the dishes on the table, and finally fell on Shen Hui.
"What are you standing for? Sit down."
Shen Hui sat down quickly.
The meal was eaten in complete silence.
No one spoke. Even the sound of chopsticks hitting the bowl was softer than usual.
Shen Hui didn't dare to look up, he just stared at the rice in his bowl, chewing it seriously.
The old Taoist priest didn't say anything. He slowly picked up the vegetables and ate slowly.
Pick up a piece of rabbit meat, chew it, and nod; pick up a piece of bamboo shoots with chopsticks, chew it, and nod again; take a sip of egg drop soup, smack your lips, and nod again.
After finishing the meal, the old Taoist priest put down his chopsticks.
Everyone also put down their chopsticks.
"I heard that you had a discussion with Jingming yesterday and said that this worldly firework is also a great medicine?" The old Taoist suddenly said.
Shen Hui's heart skipped a beat.
He raised his head and met the old Taoist priest's smiling eyes.
He remembered that the second senior sister did not eat mushrooms yesterday, but was deceived by him and ended up accidentally being tricked. He couldn't help but feel a little ashamed.
He swallowed and thought carefully before saying, "Disciple is just talking casually, but you can't take it seriously..."
"Just talking?"
The old Taoist priest smoothed his uneven beard, and there was no emotion or anger in his tone.
"I think what you said makes sense."
Shen Hui didn't dare to answer the call.
The old Taoist priest shook his head, got up and walked out, walked to the door, and said again without looking back:
"From today onwards, I will no longer live without food."
After the words fell, the figure disappeared outside the door, leaving the six disciples in shock.
…………………………………………
After the meal, Shen Hui suddenly remembered something and turned to Qingyi and said, "Third Senior Brother, I would like to borrow a few books. Do you have any miscellaneous books on geography, folk customs, and the like?"
Qingyi nodded: "There are quite a few. Do you want me to choose a few books for you, or do you want to choose them yourself?"
Just when Shen Hui was about to answer, the second senior sister suddenly said: "I have some Taoist scriptures there. If you want to read them, you can come and find me."
Shen Hui was stunned and waved his hand quickly: "Thank you, Second Senior Sister, for your kindness. It's just that my Taoism is too shallow and those Taoist teachings are too profound. It would be a waste of natural resources to see them. I really don't dare to waste them."
Jingming frowned slightly: "Then what's the use of reading those miscellaneous books? Isn't it just a waste of time and a delay in practice."
The third senior brother suddenly looked a little embarrassed when he heard this.
Shen Hui smiled indifferently and replied casually: "Senior Sister, this is wrong. As the saying goes: There is a house of gold in a book, and there is a beauty like jade in a book."
Qingyi's eyes lit up: "Junior brother, these words are very wonderful!"
Jingming's frown deepened: "Golden house? Yan Ruyu? Have you forgotten the rules? A woman with wealth and silk..."
